scripts.build: pnpm run build:site && pnpm run build:tech-docs
scripts.build:site: node scripts/general/check-sharp.js && next build site --webpack && node scripts/general/prepare-standalone.cjs
scripts.release:gate: pnpm run check:layout && pnpm run verify:focss && pnpm run test:audit && pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:ui:strict && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:a11y && pnpm run test:planner-catalog && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run test:coverage:site && pnpm run check:docs-all && pnpm run check:style-tokens && pnpm run check:governance
scripts.release:gate:fast: node scripts/general/prune-site-dumps.mjs && pnpm run check:layout && pnpm run verify:focss && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:tests && pnpm run p0:unit && pnpm run test:priority-7 && pnpm run test:priority-8 && pnpm run test:audit:fast && pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:ui:strict && pnpm run check:ui-assets && pnpm run check:launch && pnpm run check:docs-all && pnpm run check:style-tokens && pnpm run check:governance
scripts.verify:focss: node scripts/AsNeeded/verify-focss-imports.mjs && node scripts/AsNeeded/verify-site-css.mjs && node scripts/AsNeeded/verify-focss-fences.mjs && node scripts/AsNeeded/verify-focss-module-imports.mjs && node scripts/AsNeeded/verify-focss-structure.mjs
scripts.check:docs-all: node scripts/general/check-repo-layout.mjs && node scripts/general/check-failures.mjs && node scripts/general/check-agents-md.mjs && node scripts/general/check-agents-folder.mjs && node scripts/general/check-active-docs.mjs && node scripts/general/check-plans-purity.mjs && node scripts/general/check-docs-purity.mjs
scripts.check:launch: node scripts/general/validate-launch-env.mjs && node scripts/general/scan_secrets.mjs && pnpm exec tsx scripts/db_test_connection.ts
scripts.check:site-ui: node scripts/check-site-page-shell.mjs && node scripts/check-i18n-key-parity.mjs && node scripts/check-marketing-copy-source.mjs && node scripts/check-marketing-inline-style.mjs && node scripts/check-homepage-dialect.mjs
scripts.p0:unit: pnpm exec vitest run --config tests/vitest.config.ts --outputFile.json=../results/tests/vitest-p0-results.json tests/unit/lib/auth/devAuthBypass.test.ts tests/unit/planner tests/unit/studio
scripts.test:priority-7: pnpm exec vitest run --config tests/vitest.config.ts --outputFile.json=../results/tests/vitest-priority-7-results.json tests/unit/app/api/admin/_lib/server.test.ts tests/unit/lib/storage/r2Catalog.test.ts tests/integration/features/ops/CustomerQueriesOpsPageView.test.tsx tests/unit/features/ops/CustomerQueriesOpsPageView.test.tsx tests/unit/lib/catalog/publish
scripts.test:priority-8: pnpm exec vitest run --config tests/vitest.config.ts --outputFile.json=../results/tests/vitest-priority-8-results.json "tests/unit/app/(site)/robots.test.ts" "tests/unit/app/(site)/sitemap.test.ts" tests/unit/features/site/data/routeMetadata.test.ts tests/unit/features/site/data/seo.test.ts tests/unit/features/site/data/siteSeoAcceptance.test.ts tests/unit/lib/analytics/seo.test.ts tests/unit/lib/helpers/seo.test.ts tests/unit/proxy.test.ts tests/unit/app/api/csrf/route.test.ts tests/unit/features/shared/api/withAuth.test.ts tests/unit/lib/auth/devAuthBypass.test.ts tests/unit/lib/rateLimit.test.ts tests/unit/lib/security/csrf.test.ts tests/unit/scripts/generate-svg/sanitize.test.ts tests/unit/scripts/scan_secrets.test.ts tests/unit/lib/env.server.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run test:clean && pnpm exec vitest run --config tests/vitest.config.ts --coverage && node scripts/generate-coverage-report.mjs planner && node scripts/generate-vitest-report.mjs results/tests/vitest-results.json
scripts.test:coverage:site: pnpm run test:clean && pnpm exec vitest run --coverage --config tests/vitest.site.config.ts && node scripts/generate-coverage-report.mjs site && node scripts/generate-vitest-report.mjs results/tests/vitest-site-results.json
scripts.test:a11y: pnpm run test:clean && pnpm exec playwright test -c config/build/playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts
scripts.test:planner-catalog: pnpm run test:clean && pnpm exec playwright test -c config/build/playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/admin-smoke.spec.ts tests/e2e/planner-catalog.spec.ts tests/e2e/planner-guest-workspace.spec.ts tests/e2e/planner-custom-tools.spec.ts tests/e2e/planner-chrome.spec.ts tests/e2e/sketch-to-plan-pipeline.spec.ts tests/e2e/planner-offline-sync.spec.ts tests/e2e/audit-3b-planner-fixes.spec.ts tests/e2e/audit-3c-planner-polish.spec.ts
